type.trigger.note: Step types, as the palette names them; they also start a step's name in sentences (lower-cased in English)

type.step.note: a step of a type this list doesn't name

trigger.joinedList.note: Trigger kinds, in the automations list's Trigger column: Joined list · Weekly Digest

trigger.other.note: a trigger of a kind this list doesn't name

trigger.label.note: The Trigger column: kind is a trigger kind (Joined list), ref what it points at (a list's name, an event, any milestone)

ref.aList.note: What a step points at when it no longer exists or isn't known: Joined list · a list

ref.trigger.note: the flow's trigger step, in running text: A/B split after the trigger

ref.sendEmail.note: an email step with no email picked yet, as other text names it

ref.quoted.note: a step's name in running text, quoted: after "Step 2"

ref.anyEmail.note: a condition on any email of the flow: opened any email

ref.anyText.note: a condition on any text message of the flow: replied to any text

ref.scoreRises.note: a "Score crosses…" trigger; threshold is a score from 1 to 100

ref.milestone.note: a referral milestone: 3 referrals · The Acme Field Guide; reward is its reward's name

duration.message: {unit, select, minutes {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}} hours {{n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}} weeks {{n, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}} other {{n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}
duration.note: a wait or a time window: 10 minutes, 2 days

durationAdjective.note: a delay's length before the word delay: the 2-day delay

cond.opened.note: Conditions, in lower case: a branch asks them (Opened step 1 within 2 days?), a filter keeps them (Only contacts tagged vip). step is another step as running text names it (step 1) or any email

cond.clickedUrl.note: url is what the link contains: clicked a docs link

cond.sentEvent.note: an API event arrived for the contact; event is its name (account.activated)

cond.bought.note: product: its name, any product or a deleted product

cond.fieldSet.note: a contact field (plan) compared with a value

cond.fieldOneOf.note: values are alternatives: plan is team or business

cond.smsConsent.note: Conditions on text messages, in lower case

cond.smsClicked.note: text is a Send SMS step as running text names it, or any text

title.pickTrigger.note: Step titles: the bold line of a step on the canvas, and how the diff and problems name it

title.branch.note: a branch asks its condition, which starts with a capital: Opened step 1 within 2 days?

title.filter.note: condition in lower case: Only contacts tagged vip

title.splitOn.note: an A/B split: its weights (50 / 50) and the step its first path leads to

title.exit: Leave the flow · stays on the list

goal.end.message: Reached the end of the flow
goal.end.note: Goals, as the automations list's Goal column and the canvas name them

step.named.note: a step named in a problem: branch "Opened step 1 within 2 days?"; type is the step's type in lower case

problem.empty: The flow is empty. Drag a trigger onto the canvas to start.
problem.duplicateId: Two steps share the id "{id}". Delete one and add it again.
problem.noTrigger: The flow has no trigger. Drag one from Triggers so contacts can enter.
problem.manyTriggers: A flow has one trigger. Delete the extra ones.
problem.danglingEdge: A connection points to a step that no longer exists. Delete it.
problem.selfLoop: A step can't lead to itself.
problem.duplicateEdge: Two connections join the same steps. Delete one.
problem.cycle: The flow loops back to an earlier step. Flows run top to bottom; remove the connection that goes back up.
problem.triggerInput: Nothing can lead into the trigger. Remove the connection into it.

problem.orphan.message: {step} isn't connected to the trigger, so no contact would reach it. Connect it or delete it.
problem.orphan.note: step: Branch "Opened step 1 within 2 days?", or The trigger

problem.goalOutputs: {step} leads to {count} steps. Keep one connection.
problem.terminalOutput: {step} ends the flow, so it can't lead to another step.

problem.missingPath.message: {step} has no "{path}" path. Connect it to a step or an exit.
problem.missingPath.note: path: Yes, No, or an A/B split's letter

problem.unknownPath.message: A connection out of {step} isn't one of its paths. Delete it and connect again.
problem.unknownPath.note: step in lower case: branch "Opened step 1 within 2 days?"

problem.manyOutputs: {step} leads to {count} steps. Only branches and splits fork; keep one connection.
problem.triggerKind: Pick what starts the flow: a list join, a form, a tag, an API event, a date or a score.
problem.triggerListDeleted: The trigger's list was deleted. Pick another list.
problem.triggerFormDeleted: The trigger's form was deleted. Pick another form.
problem.triggerTag: Name the tag that starts the flow (letters, numbers, spaces and - _ . : /).
problem.triggerEvent: Name the API event, like workspace.created (letters, numbers and . _ : -).
problem.triggerPollDeleted: The trigger's poll or survey was deleted. Pick another one.
problem.triggerFieldDeleted: The trigger's date field was deleted. Pick another field.
problem.triggerFieldType: The trigger needs a date field.
problem.triggerMilestoneDeleted: The trigger's milestone was deleted. Pick another milestone.
problem.delayMax: Delays can be at most a year.
problem.emailDeleted: This step's email was deleted. Pick another email.
problem.routeGone: The sending provider this step overrides to was disconnected. Use the Automations route.
problem.skipListDeleted: The "Skip if" list was deleted. Pick another list or clear the rule.
problem.subject: Write a subject line.
problem.sendWindow: Set the send window as two different times like 07:00 and 21:00.
problem.openClickWindow: Set how long to wait for the open or click.
problem.pickField: Pick the contact field to check.
problem.conditionFieldDeleted: The condition's field was deleted. Pick another field.
problem.fieldOp: Pick how to compare the field.
problem.conditionListDeleted: The condition's list was deleted. Pick another list.
problem.conditionEvent: Name the API event, like teammate.invited.
problem.clickReplyWindow: Set how long to wait for the click or reply.
problem.splitVariants: An A/B split needs at least two variants.
problem.splitLetter: Each variant needs its own letter.

problem.splitWeights.message: The split's weights add up to {sum, number, percent}. Make them add up to 100%.

problem.webhookFullUrl.message: enter a full URL starting with https://
problem.webhookFullUrl.note: Problems with a webhook step's URL, shown as they are (they start in lower case in English)

problem.webhookScheme: webhooks call http:// or https:// URLs
problem.webhookCredentials: put credentials in the signing secret, not in the URL
problem.webhookPrivate: webhooks can't call private, loopback or internal addresses
problem.listAction: Pick what to do: add or remove a list or a tag.
problem.stepListDeleted: This step's list was deleted. Pick another list.
problem.smsConsentList: Pick the list whose SMS consent the step needs.
problem.consentListDeleted: The step's consent list was deleted. Pick another list.
problem.pushLink: Add the address the notification opens.
problem.whatsappConsentList: Pick the list whose WhatsApp consent the step needs.
problem.scoreDirection: The score rises to the threshold or falls below it.
problem.scoreThreshold: Set the score that starts the flow, from 1 to 100.

problem.scoreOnce.message: Limit re-entry to at most once in 1 to {max, number} days, or leave it off.

problem.productDeleted: The product was deleted. Pick another product, or any product.
problem.storeGone: The trigger's store isn't connected any more. Reconnect it or pick another store.
problem.checkoutWait: An abandoned checkout waits 1 to 24 hours for an order.
problem.eventName: Name the event with letters, numbers and . _ : -, like workspace.created.
problem.noContact: No contact with that email in this workspace. Add the contact first, then send the event.
problem.eventWho: Say who the event is about: email or contactId.
problem.template: There's no starter template with that name. Pick welcome-series, re-engagement, onboarding or abandoned-cart.
problem.listNotInWorkspace: That list isn't in this workspace.
problem.name: Give the automation a name.
problem.graphSize: A flow can have up to {steps} steps and {connections} connections.
problem.revision: Someone else saved this automation since you opened it. Reload to get their changes; yours stay in this tab until you do.
problem.neverPublished: This automation was never published, so there's no live version to go back to. Delete it instead.
problem.secretLength: Use a signing secret of at least 16 characters.
problem.emailEmpty: The email is empty. Write its HTML.
problem.emailSize: Keep the email under 512 KB; Gmail clips anything over 102 KB anyway.
problem.storeNotInWorkspace: That store isn't connected to this workspace.
problem.connectStore: Connect a store first: the Abandoned cart starter starts on a store's abandoned checkouts.
problem.eventSession: The event needs a start time and a date field.
problem.draftMoved: The draft is now v{version}. Review the changes again before publishing.
problem.alreadyLive: v{version} is already live. Edit the flow to start a new version.

problem.fixOnCanvas.message: {problem} Fix it on the canvas, then publish.
problem.fixOnCanvas.note: problem is the first problem of the flow, a sentence

problem.changedAfterApproval: The draft changed after approval (now v{version}); request approval again.
problem.pauseNotLive: Only a live automation can be paused.
problem.resumeNotPaused: Only a paused automation can be resumed.

check.routeHealthy.note: Publish dialog badges. providers: SES, Postmark

check.routeDown: No healthy provider on the Automations route: emails wait until one is
check.emailsPass: {count, plural, one {# email passes content checks} other {# emails pass content checks}}
check.noDeletedRefs: No step references a deleted list or tag
check.splitPaths: A/B split has every path connected

check.languageOutdated.note: step: the email step's number; language: German

check.noSubject.note: Why an email fails the content checks, after its step's name: "Step 2": no unsubscribe link

check.noAlt: an image has no alt text
blocker.noChanges: Nothing to publish: there are no changes since v{version}.
blocker.onlyMoves: Nothing to publish: the draft only moves steps around v{version}.

estimate.now.note: When the old version retires, at the end of: v3 retires when the last contact leaves, about 9 days.

move.waiting.message: {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}} waiting before {step} would get the {delay} delay
move.waiting.note: What moving contacts to the new version does, a clause; delay: 2-day

move.removed.message: {count, plural, one {# contact is} other {# contacts are}} affected by the removed {kind}

move.impact.note: the clauses above, joined with semicolons

move.none: Contacts keep their place; changed steps apply from where each contact is now.

diff.headTrigger.note: Version diff lines. trigger: Joined list · Weekly Digest

diff.after.note: an added or removed step and the step before it: A/B split after "Step 2"

diff.emailRef.note: a new email step in a list: 3A "Set up your first flag"; step is its step, subject the quote of the email's name

diff.newEmails.message: {count, plural, =1 {One new email step: {emails}.} =2 {Two new email steps: {emails}.} =3 {Three new email steps: {emails}.} =4 {Four new email steps: {emails}.} =5 {Five new email steps: {emails}.} =6 {Six new email steps: {emails}.} =7 {Seven new email steps: {emails}.} =8 {Eight new email steps: {emails}.} =9 {Nine new email steps: {emails}.} other {# new email steps: {emails}.}}
diff.newEmails.note: emails: 3A "Set up your first flag" and 3B "A 5-minute walkthrough"

diff.checksFail.note: failures: "Step 3": no unsubscribe link; "Step 4": the email is empty

diff.checksPass: {count, plural, =1 {It passes Send Readiness content checks.} =2 {Both pass Send Readiness content checks.} other {All # pass Send Readiness content checks.}}

diff.webhookFailing.message: Endpoint {url} was returning {hasStatus, select, yes {{status}} other {errors}} since {date}. {count, number} failed calls are in the webhook log.
diff.webhookFailing.note: status: an HTTP status (404); date: 29 Sep

diff.removedEmail: Contacts who haven't reached it yet won't get it.
diff.delayDetail: Contacts already waiting keep their original timer unless you move them to v{version} below.
diff.emailDetail: Contacts who already got this email won't get it again.
diff.triggerDetail: Contacts already in the flow stay; new entrants come from the new trigger.
diff.branchDetail: Contacts waiting at the branch are checked against the new condition if you move them to v{version}.

diff.rewire.note: changes: the "No" path goes to "Step 3" and the "Yes" path goes to "Wait 2 days"

diff.languages.note: languages: Spanish and German; steps: steps 1 to 3

steps.one.note: email steps by number: step 2, steps 1 to 3, steps 1 and 3

unchanged.trigger.note: The diff's last line lists what stayed the same: Trigger, step 1, branch, "No" path, goal and exit

summary.blank.note: Version history: what a version is. Starts in lower case after the date and who

summary.duplicated.note: name: the automation it was copied from

summary.added.note: a change of a version in the history: added email "Step 3" after "Step 2"

alert.webhookFails.note: Alerts above the automations list. flow: the automation's name; name: the webhook step's name or host

alert.webhookFailsWith.note: error: the network's error, as it reported it

alert.webhookDetail.message: {count, number} calls failed since {date}. Contacts continue past the step; the flow isn't blocked. Remove the step or fix the URL, then publish.

alert.heldTitle: "{flow}" paused: no healthy provider on the Automations route

alert.heldDetail.message: {problems}. {count, plural, one {# email is} other {# emails are}} queued and will send the moment a provider is healthy; delays in the flow keep counting.
alert.heldDetail.note: problems: what is wrong with each provider of the route, or that none is set up

alert.noProvider: No sending provider is set up for automations

alert.fallback.note: the route's fallback provider, inside a sentence: Postmark, the fallback, returned 401

alert.authStatus: {provider} returned {status}: its API key or token was rejected
alert.auth: {provider} rejected its API key or token

alert.status.message: {provider} is {status, select, healthy {healthy} degraded {degraded} down {down} sandbox {sandbox} warming_up {warming up} paused {paused} other {{statusName}}}

alert.statusDetail.message: {provider} is {status, select, healthy {healthy} degraded {degraded} down {down} sandbox {sandbox} warming_up {warming up} paused {paused} other {{statusName}}} ({detail})
alert.statusDetail.note: detail: what the provider reported, as it reported it (Disconnected)
